wikipediaSummary.title: Mott (album)
wikipediaSummary.description: 1973 studio album by Mott the Hoople
wikipediaSummary.extract: Mott is the sixth studio album by British rock band Mott the Hoople. It peaked at No. 7 in the UK Albums Chart. It is the last album to feature guitarist Mick Ralphs, and the first without organist Verden Allen; because of Allen's departure, most organ and other keyboard parts are played by Ralphs.
